fields.value: I-64 W near Greenbrier Pkwy, Chesapeake, VA

sections.heading: Officer narrative
sections.body: Vehicle observed varying speed 45-70 mph and crossing lane markings at 2314 hours. Traffic stop initiated. Driver identified as BELL, MARCUS T by VA operator's license. Odor of alcoholic beverage, bloodshot eyes; subject cooperative. SFSTs indicated impairment. Breath test at station: 0.18% BAC. Subject booked, printed, and released on summons to a sober third party.
